AC_BASIC.DISTP_ENTRY.lov: select entry_type || ' - ' || max(case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(entry_desc_e, entry_desc) else entry_desc end) d, entry_type r from ac_trn_codes where nvl(ac_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (entry_year, entry_type) in (select p1.entry_year, p1.entry_type from ac_password_entry p1 where p1.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p1.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) group by entry_type order by entry_type

AC_BASIC.INCOME1_ACCT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select p2.account_number from ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number
